command.liveWatch: STM32 Project Helper: Open Live Variables
stm32ProjectHelper.liveWatch.tclPort: Local OpenOCD Tcl port. Use 0 to detect it automatically.
stm32ProjectHelper.liveWatch.gdbPath: ARM GDB executable path. Leave empty to use the debugger or detected toolchain.
stm32ProjectHelper.liveWatch.elfPath: Firmware ELF with debug symbols. Leave empty to detect the active firmware.
stm32ProjectHelper.liveWatch.ramRegions: RAM ranges allowed for live memory access, e.g. 0x24000000-0x2407FFFF (end inclusive). Leave empty to use common STM32 RAM ranges.
description: Local STM32 project tools: CubeMX Keil MDK-ARM/CMake conversion, ARM GCC environment checks, VS Code build and DAPLink flash tasks, source management, and change restoration.
trust: A trusted local Windows workspace is required to run build tools and modify projects.
command.signals: STM32 Project Helper: Open Live Signals
stm32ProjectHelper.autoOpen: Automatically open Project Helper when a supported project is detected.
stm32ProjectHelper.tools.cMake: CMake executable path. Leave empty for automatic detection.
language.description: Interface language. Auto follows the VS Code display language. Changes apply to new interactions after the current operation finishes.
language.auto.description: Use the VS Code display language.
command.fixIntelligence: STM32 Project Helper: Fix Global Code Intelligence
